destinations.name: Gir National Park
destinations.location: Sasan Gir and Devalia visitor area, Gujarat
destinations.best_time: Late November to early March (cool and dry season)
destinations.description: The Gir landscape is habitat for the Asiatic lion. Visitors can book guided vehicle safaris from Sasan Gir or visit the separate Gir Interpretation Zone at Devalia.
destinations.seasonal_note: Main jungle safari operates in seasonal slots; advance permits required. Devalia bus safari closes Wednesdays. This application does not enforce dated permit availability.

destinations.name: Somnath
destinations.image_alt: Shree Somnath Jyotirlinga Temple - Gujarat Tourism
destinations.description: Somnath, also known as Prabhas Patan, is a coastal pilgrimage destination near Veraval. Visitors come to the Somnath Jyotirlinga temple and nearby sites associated with Krishna.

destinations.name: Dwarka
destinations.description: Dwarka is a coastal pilgrimage town associated with Krishna. Its principal sites include the Dwarkadhish temple, Rukmini temple and Nageshwar Jyotirlinga, with Bet Dwarka offshore near Okha.

destinations.name: Champaner
destinations.description: Champaner and Pavagadh form a UNESCO World Heritage archaeological landscape containing fortifications, temples, mosques and historic water structures. Champaner preserves remains of the Gujarat Sultanate's former capital.

destinations.name: Saputara
destinations.description: Saputara is a hill town in the Sahyadri range in southern Gujarat. Its lake, hill viewpoints and museum introduce visitors to the landscape and culture of the Dangs.
destinations.seasonal_note: Check weather and local access before visiting hill viewpoints. Museum reopening has not been confirmed.

destinations.name: Ahmedabad
destinations.description: Ahmedabad has historic Hindu, Islamic and Jain monuments and traditional neighbourhoods known as pols. Its visitor sites include Gandhi Ashram and museums.

destinations.name: Modhera
destinations.description: Modhera stands near the Pushpavati River in north Gujarat. Its principal monument is the Solanki-era Sun Temple, with a sculpted assembly hall and stepped reservoir; the village also contains the Modheshwari Mata shrine.
destinations.distance_from_ahmedabad: 99 km by road to Sun Temple (Gujarat Tourism)

destinations.name: Rann of Kutch
destinations.location: Dhordo and the Great Rann visitor area, Kutch, Gujarat
destinations.image_alt: Kalo Dungar (The Black Hills) - Gujarat Tourism
destinations.description: The Great Rann is a seasonal salt landscape in northern Kutch. Dhordo provides access to the White Rann, while Kalo Dungar offers elevated views over the surrounding region.
destinations.seasonal_note: The white salt surface depends on weather and water conditions; monsoon conditions can change access and appearance. Permit requirements apply.

attractions.name: Adalaj Ni Vav Stepwell
attractions.source: Gujarat Tourism Official 2026
attractions.description: Adalaj's five-storey stepwell was commissioned by Queen Rudabai in 1499. Carved pillars and walls surround the descent to the well.

attractions.name: Modhera Sun Temple
attractions.source: Gujarat Tourism; ASI ticketing listings; OpenStreetMap
attractions.entry_fee: INR20 Indian online admission; foreign online ticket INR250; booking conditions apply
attractions.description: The Sun Temple complex contains a carved shrine hall, an assembly hall and Surya Kund, a stepped reservoir lined with small shrines. It dates to the Solanki period.
attractions.best_time_note: Stored hours follow Gujarat Tourism's visitor brochure. Other sources describe sunrise to sunset. Two hours is a published visitor-duration recommendation, not a fixed tour. General wheelchair access remains unverified; entrance amenities do not establish access to stepped areas.

provenance_review.notes: Current online fee preferred over conflicting historical brochures. Duration upper end of operator's 90-120 minute recommendation. attractions.source: Gujarat Tourism Official 2026
attractions.image_alt: Shree Somnath Jyotirlinga Temple - Gujarat Tourism

attractions.name: Dwarkadhish Temple

attractions.name: Sarkhej Roza
attractions.source: Gujarat Tourism Official 2026
attractions.description: Sarkhej Roza is a mosque, tomb and palace complex associated with the Sufi saint Ahmed Khattu Ganj Baksh. Historic buildings surround a large tank.
attractions.best_time_note: A commercial walking-tour listing explicitly says its Sarkhej Roza tour is not wheelchair accessible. This does not establish accessibility of every part of the monument; confirm an appropriate entrance and route with the site.

attractions.name: Triveni Sangam
attractions.source: Gujarat Tourism Official 2026
attractions.description: Triveni Sangam is the pilgrimage ghat where the Hiran, Kapila and Saraswati rivers are traditionally identified as meeting the Arabian Sea.
attractions.best_time_note: The visitor area includes stepped ghats. Wheelchair access to the water is unverified.
